note: Brief 107 (Latch, from Glint's page briefs/107/glint/weather.html; Glint tunes). Look only: no rule reads any of it. Per kind: sun (x the sun's intensity), ambient (x the trilight by day), desaturate (0..1: the sun's colour toward grey, the ambient a little cooler), shadow (x the sun's shadow strength), wet (0..1: porous ground darker and glossier), puddles (0..1: the share of flat ground at the plan's levels under water), ripples (0..1), rain (0..1: the falling streaks' density), streaks (0..1: the lamps' reflections in the wet), mist (0..1: the ground mist). mistDay and mistNight: the mist's colour.
